EC shows its own "UNSAVED CHANGES" Yes/No/Cancel confirm when navigating away from a dirty New Object form. If an earlier step failed mid-fill (e.g. a dependent-dropdown timeout), this dialog can be left open and its overlay mask (#confirmationForm:confirmation_modal) then intercepts every click for the rest of the run - the whole suite silently stalls behind it. Detect + discard via No, so a single earlier failure can't cascade into the entire suite hanging.
